steps.label: Start Canvas service renewal review
steps.intent:
**Input:** The /renew-a-household-service-personal command arguments.

**Processing:** Initializes a browserless workflow context for the contiguous inline Canvas task sequence.

**Output:** A Canvas-ready execution context; no browser or external connector is opened.

steps.label: Gmail — read_contract
steps.intent:
**Input:** Existing renewal case SLOANE-RENEW-001 at intake.

**Processing:** Opens the first Canvas card for an explicitly approved, read-only Gmail.read_contract operation on the renewal notice and contract terms. When Gmail is not intentionally connected, the card states it is using the seeded Northline Fiber notice rather than claiming a live read. Approval advances the existing case from intake to contract_read.

**Output:** Renewal notice and contract terms persisted on the case advanced to contract_read. No email is sent or modified.

taskTypes.label: Gmail — read_contract
taskTypes.description: Gmail.read_contract — Read the home-internet renewal notice and current contract terms. For the mock fallback path, use the seeded SLOANE-RENEW-001 notice exactly: provider Northline Fiber, plan Home Gigabit, current $59.99/mo, proposed $89.99/mo (50% hike), contract end 2026-09-14, promo note 'First-year rate ending'. Clearly label the source as mock fallback when live Gmail has no match. Drafts only — never send or modify email.

personaCapabilityConfig.promptTemplate: Read the home-internet renewal notice and draft a negotiation brief. Use SLOANE-RENEW-001 Northline Fiber mock fallback unless a live Gmail connector is explicitly selected and approved. Drafts only, never send. {args}

steps.label: Sheets — summarize_usage
steps.intent:
**Input:** The approved SLOANE-RENEW-001 Gmail card and persisted contract_read case.

**Processing:** Opens the second Canvas card for an explicitly approved, read-only Sheets.summarize_usage operation on monthly spend and usage. The mock path uses the exact seeded six months (average ~437 GB at a flat $59.99) and the $64.99 competitor offer. Approval advances the same case from contract_read to usage_summarized.

**Output:** Persisted usage_summarized case with monthly spend and usage. No sheet is modified and no email is sent.

taskTypes.label: Sheets — summarize_usage
taskTypes.description: Sheets.summarize_usage — Summarize monthly spend and usage. For the mock fallback path, use the exact seeded SLOANE-RENEW-001 usage history (six months, average ~437 GB at a flat $59.99) and competitor offer ($64.99/mo for a comparable plan). State it is using the seeded values unless a live Sheets connector is explicitly selected and approved. Drafts only — never write to Sheets.

personaCapabilityConfig.promptTemplate: Summarize the seeded six-month usage for SLOANE-RENEW-001 (average ~437 GB at a flat $59.99) unless a live Sheets connector is explicitly selected and approved. Keep the same numbers literally. {args}

steps.label: Gmail — draft_email
steps.intent:
**Input:** The approved usage_summarized case SLOANE-RENEW-001.

**Processing:** Opens the third Canvas card to draft the negotiation email as a Gmail draft only. The draft uses the contract end 2026-09-14, the 50% hike to $89.99/mo, the ~437 GB average, and the $64.99 competitor talking point. The case stays at usage_summarized for review until approved. Improve revises the draft without sending (revise_draft).

**Output:** A negotiation email draft (never sent) persisted for review while the case remains usage_summarized.

taskTypes.label: Gmail — draft_email
taskTypes.description: Gmail.draft_email — Draft the negotiation email for SLOANE-RENEW-001 with the contract end 2026-09-14, hike %, proposed monthly $89.99, and the $64.99 competitor talking point. Stay at usage_summarized for review until approved. Create a Gmail draft only — never send. Improve revises the draft without sending (revise_draft).

personaCapabilityConfig.promptTemplate: Draft the negotiation email for SLOANE-RENEW-001 as a Gmail draft only, never send. On Improve, revise the draft via revise_draft without sending. Keep the case at usage_summarized for review. {args}

steps.label: Mark draft ready
steps.intent:
**Input:** The approved draft-email Canvas card and the same usage_summarized SLOANE-RENEW-001 case.

**Processing:** Runs the terminal mark_draft_ready transition only after the draft email review completes with Looks good. Advances the persisted case from usage_summarized to draft_ready without sending an email or changing any plan.

**Output:** The approved negotiation draft remains persisted and the case reaches draft_ready. No email is sent, no plan is changed, and no bill is paid.

taskTypes.label: Mark draft ready
taskTypes.description: After the approved negotiation draft, advance the case from usage_summarized to draft_ready. No email is sent and no plan is changed.

taskTypes.label: Gmail — read_contract
taskTypes.description: Gmail.read_contract — use the approved live read or explicitly identified SLOANE-RENEW-001 Northline Fiber notice.

taskTypes.label: Sheets — summarize_usage
taskTypes.description: Sheets.summarize_usage — use the exact SLOANE-RENEW-001 six-month usage (average ~437 GB at a flat $59.99) and $64.99 competitor offer unless a live connector is approved.

taskTypes.label: Gmail — draft_email
taskTypes.description: Gmail.draft_email — draft the negotiation email for SLOANE-RENEW-001 as a Gmail draft only. Never send. Keep at usage_summarized until approved; Improve revises (revise_draft).

taskTypes.label: Mark draft ready
taskTypes.description: Advance the approved case from usage_summarized to draft_ready. No email is sent and no plan is changed.

personaCapabilityConfig.promptTemplate: Return the final SLOANE-RENEW-001 renewal brief after approved draft review. Preserve Northline Fiber, Home Gigabit, $59.99 -> $89.99 at 2026-09-14, ~437 GB average, $64.99 competitor offer, the negotiation email draft (never sent), case stage draft_ready, and the exact completion sentence: 'Renewal brief created with negotiation points and an email draft.' {args}

commitMessage: Repair workflow with contiguous Canvas task sequence (Gmail -> Sheets -> Gmail draft -> mark ready)
